definitions.explanation: At an unspecified time in the future.

definitions.gloss: at some point, before one knows it
definitions.explanation: At an unspecified time, often referring to the past.

examples.japanese: いつか{日本|にほん}に{行|い}きたい。
examples.english: I want to go to Japan someday.

examples.japanese: いつかまた{会|あ}いましょう。
いつか{見|み}た{映画|えいが}だ。
examples.english: It's a movie I saw at some point.

examples.japanese: いつか{自分|じぶん}の{店|みせ}を{持|も}ちたい。
examples.english: I want to have my own store someday.

examples.japanese: いつか{聞|き}いた{話|はなし}を{思|おも}い{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I remembered a story I heard at some point.

examples.japanese: いつか{必|かなら}ず{成功|せいこう}する。
いつか{読|よ}んだ{本|ほん}の{内容|ないよう}を{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I forgot the contents of a book I read sometime ago.

examples.japanese: いつか{世界|せかい}が{平和|へいわ}になってほしい。
examples.english: I hope the world becomes peaceful someday.

examples.japanese: いつか{会|あ}った{人|ひと}に{似|に}ている。
examples.english: You resemble someone I met at some point.

examples.japanese: いつか{夢|ゆめ}を{叶|かな}えたい。
examples.english: I want to make my dream come true someday.

notes:
いつか refers to an unspecified time.

FUTURE USE:
- いつか + verb (someday will ~)
- いつか{必|かなら}ず (someday for sure)

PAST USE:
- いつか + past verb (at some point ~)
- いつかどこかで (sometime somewhere)

WRITING:
- Usually hiragana
- Can be written {何時|いつ}か

NOTE:
- いつか (someday) vs {五日|いつか} (5th day) - context distinguishes them
